entities.summary: Lee Hsi-ming is a retired Taiwanese admiral who was the Chief of the General Staff of the Republic of China Armed Forces from 2017 to 2019. He is currently an adjunct professor at National Chengchi University and a non-resident senior research fellow of the Institute for Indo-Pacific Security. He was previously also Taiwan's vice minister of national defense for policy from 2016 to 2017 and the commander of the Republic of China Navy from 2015 to 2016.
